dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped rings on the upper mid-dorsal region exhibit sharp, dark perimeters transitioning to high-intensity white centers via a steep gradient. Two 'C' shaped structures on the mid-lateral region show irregular, jagged outer perimeters with a more gradual grayscale transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, low-intensity (dark) solid blobs concentrated on the anterior dorsal/snout region. Large clusters of saturated high-intensity (white) pixels on the posterior-lateral region, representing regions of specular reflection where internal texture is lost.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary macro-annuli on the upper back form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented along the cranio-caudal axis. A cluster of four smaller dark blobs on the lateral midsection forms an irregular quadrilateral.
